latlon_comment: Used to determine when it's dark outside, and lights should automatically turn on
doorbell_cam_alias_comment: cam_alias of the doorbell camera, as configured in ZmwReolinkCams
allowed_paths_comment: Dirs snapshots may come from (ZmwReolinkCams' snap_path_on_movement). Snaps elsewhere are ignored: not recorded, served or forwarded
relay_raw_cam_events_comment: Also send the camera's own motion snapshot to WhatsApp ('Motion detected', at most one every 2 minutes), for any motion, person or not. Visitor notifications (from ZmwVisitorDetect) cover people at the door; enable this to be notified of all motion, or as a fallback when ZmwVisitorDetect isn't running
visitor_face_wait_secs_comment: People at the door are sent to WhatsApp from ZmwVisitorDetect: after it reports a person, wait this long for a face, and send the person picture if none arrived. In a backtest over 26 recorded visits that did show a face, 5 s caught it in 69% of them (3 s: 50%, 10 s: 81%). Faces arriving later are sent as a follow-up. At night there are no faces, so the person picture goes out at once
visitor_notify_repeat_secs_comment: Don't notify the same person (a known visitor, 'unknown visitor' or 'someone') again within this time
visitor_notify_injected_comment: Also notify sessions from clips injected for testing (ZmwVisitorDetect's inject_clip)
presence_correlation_window_secs_comment: Time window to correlate user arrival with door open events
